attributes.action: Make the Jubilee Line operate longer after midnight on concert nights
attributes.additional_details:
Some people find it hard or overwhelming to get home after concerts and often the Jubilee line gets packed and makes it harder for people to get home, especially after midnight. Not everyone has another way of transport to help them get home.

I believe everyone should have a fair, quick, and safe journey home to get to which is why I believe the Jubilee line should operate for longer until at least 2am.
attributes.background:
I believe that the jubilee line should operate longer on concert nights as crowds get packed + makes it harder for people to get home. I believe everyone can have a safe journey home.

There are often concerts (almost) everyday, e.g. O2 Arena at North Greenwich or Wembley Stadium at Wembley Park.

rejection.details:
Petitions must call for a specific action that the UK Government or House of Commons is responsible for.

Decisions about London tube services are a matter for Transport for London, not the Government or House of Commons. As a result it is not possible for the Government or House of Commons to take the action you have requested.

The London Assembly has its own petitions process. You can find out more about how to petition the London Assembly here: https://www.london.gov.uk/about-us/london-assembly/petitions
